## Design

### 2026-10-10 – I designed the first part of the wind tunnel, which is the inlet. The inlet is an opening that draws drived air into the circuit. It isolates the tunnel from outside disturbances, and it also transfor

**2h**

I designed the first part of the wind tunnel, which is the inlet. The inlet is an opening that draws drived air into the circuit. It isolates the tunnel from outside disturbances, and it also transforms the air into a smooth, straight-line stream. I attached a real-world example of an inlet.
